summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its first export of naturally derived psilocybin to the United Kingdom for a planned Phase 2 clinical trial. The shipment includes biomass and 5mg capsules, made under Health Canada and UK Home Office authorization. This is a routine operational update regarding a product export and does not involve any merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation. No deal terms are disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report with no transformative corporate event.
